archetypes.name: Airport terminal concession
archetypes.mission: enplaning, deplaning, connecting and worker flow exposed to the location
archetypes.decision_object: current terminal concession package in the exact security zone
archetypes.required_gate: airport, terminal, security side, circulation zone and live concession package
prohibited_substitutions: airport centroid or neighborhood population cannot create terminal demand
airside and landside flows cannot be merged

archetypes.name: Arena / event concession
archetypes.mission: ticketed attendees and workers traversing the same venue zone
archetypes.decision_object: current concession package in the exact venue zone
archetypes.required_gate: named venue, live concession package and governed event calendar
prohibited_substitutions: nearby resident population cannot replace ticketed attendance
event peaks cannot be annualized into an ordinary day

archetypes.name: Campus-adjacent street counter
archetypes.mission: students, faculty and staff using public campus access
archetypes.required_gate: public storefront routed to an accessible public campus gate or entrance within the 5/10-minute contract
prohibited_substitutions: education jobs cannot replace enrollment
H3 adjacency cannot cross a private campus boundary

archetypes.name: Campus-captive kiosk
archetypes.mission: authorized campus population using governed internal paths
archetypes.decision_object: current food-service opportunity inside the governed campus access regime
archetypes.required_gate: named campus building/internal zone and live institutional food-service opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: external neighborhood population cannot be added
campus anchor cannot create an available kiosk

archetypes.name: Cultural-venue cafe
archetypes.mission: venue visitors, staff and authorized users exposed to the same governed internal zone during venue operating and programming hours
archetypes.decision_object: open museum, library or theater/performing-arts place with an unambiguous exact-intersection building assignment plus a separately observed cafe or concession opportunity
archetypes.required_gate: named venue, internal/public access zone and live food-service opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: venue presence cannot replace attendance
nearby residents cannot be added to internal demand

archetypes.name: Destination flagship
archetypes.mission: Primary evidence components: TOURIST_VISITOR, SHOPPING_ERRAND
archetypes.decision_object: available and legally usable large-format public cafe unit supporting the declared flagship, event, queue, accessibility, egress and back-of-house program
archetypes.required_gate: destination-access contract plus flagship-scale available property and program feasibility
prohibited_substitutions: destination place density cannot replace visits
property scale cannot add customer demand

archetypes.name: Destination high-street cafe
archetypes.mission: shopping, culture, leisure, visitor and supporting resident-worker origins exposed to the corridor
archetypes.decision_object: independently accessed street-facing cafe unit on a contiguous named retail, culture or leisure corridor
archetypes.required_gate: governed destination corridor, storefront access and appropriate high-street unit
prohibited_substitutions: place composition cannot create visitor counts
tourism guide labels cannot create a numeric score

archetypes.name: Destination roastery flagship
archetypes.mission: Primary evidence components: TOURIST_VISITOR, SHOPPING_ERRAND
archetypes.decision_object: destination flagship with observed co-located roasting or production, compatible legal use, building systems, storage, emissions/fire controls and loading access
archetypes.required_gate: #26 destination contract plus production, loading, zoning and program feasibility
prohibited_substitutions: production capacity cannot add customer demand
roastery program cannot create visitor counts

archetypes.name: Drive-through coffee
archetypes.mission: vehicle origins and compatible pass-by routes
archetypes.decision_object: zoning- and geometry-feasible parcel with legal access, turning and queue stacking
archetypes.required_gate: legally feasible parcel with governed ingress, egress, turn, queue and directed-drive catchment
prohibited_substitutions: walkability or population density cannot replace vehicle flow
road proximity cannot replace legal access

archetypes.name: Hospital-captive kiosk
archetypes.mission: staff, patient-family and visitor flow on governed accessible internal connections
archetypes.decision_object: current food-service opportunity inside the named medical facility
archetypes.required_gate: named facility/building/access zone and live food-service opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: nearby population cannot replace facility flow
healthcare jobs cannot create patient or visitor counts

archetypes.name: Hotel-lobby cafe
archetypes.mission: hotel guests, workers, meetings and authorized visitors exposed to the same lobby or governed internal circulation
archetypes.decision_object: open hotel place with an unambiguous exact-intersection building assignment plus a separately observed lobby cafe opportunity
archetypes.required_gate: named hotel, lobby/internal zone, access regime and live operator opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: hotel count or reviews cannot replace occupied rooms
nearby visitors cannot be added without lobby access

archetypes.name: Industrial / logistics district counter
archetypes.mission: shift workers, drivers and industrial employees
archetypes.decision_object: publicly accessible storefront or counter with a safe legal walking route
archetypes.required_gate: industrial/logistics land-use-qualified district plus safe legal route to a verified workplace gate
prohibited_substitutions: generic construction jobs cannot qualify an industrial district
blue-collar count cannot replace shift or driver flow

archetypes.name: Mall / food-court kiosk
archetypes.mission: shoppers and employees using the same enclosed circulation
archetypes.required_gate: named mall, internal circulation/food-court zone and live leasable unit
prohibited_substitutions: nearby retail places cannot replace mall trips
external population cannot be added to internal circulation

archetypes.name: Medical-district street counter
archetypes.mission: staff, visitors and patient-family access
archetypes.required_gate: public storefront routed to accessible public medical entrances within the 5/8-minute contract
prohibited_substitutions: healthcare jobs cannot replace patient or visitor flow
staff-only entrances cannot create public demand

archetypes.name: Permitted mobile street cart
archetypes.mission: pedestrian flow reaching the operating point
archetypes.decision_object: current permitted unit at a legally eligible point and time
archetypes.required_gate: current permit/operator, legally eligible exact location and operating window
prohibited_substitutions: components are alternative missions and must not be summed
strong demand cannot create a legal vending right

archetypes.name: Neighborhood seated coffeehouse
archetypes.mission: resident, social, study and light-work origins using a planned local visit
archetypes.decision_object: independently accessed street-facing cafe unit capable of the brand's seating, accessibility, restroom, service and dwell requirements
archetypes.required_gate: public seated storefront with neighborhood pedestrian catchment and suitable unit/program
prohibited_substitutions: resident count cannot establish seated dwell, study or social occasion
takeaway demand cannot be increased merely because the unit is larger

archetypes.name: Neighborhood main-street takeaway
archetypes.mission: resident and routine origins
archetypes.decision_object: independent street-facing storefront on a walkable neighborhood retail street
archetypes.required_gate: public street-facing storefront with governed pedestrian-network catchment
prohibited_substitutions: tourist places cannot replace resident routine
night-light cannot replace night demand

archetypes.name: Office-district coffeehouse
archetypes.mission: weekday office-worker workplace blocks
archetypes.decision_object: independently accessed street-facing coffeehouse unit capable of seating, meetings, accessibility, restroom and longer dwell
archetypes.required_gate: public seated storefront routed to qualified workplaces with suitable unit/program
prohibited_substitutions: office jobs cannot establish meetings, dwell or occupancy
street demand cannot be counted again as lobby demand

archetypes.name: Office-district street express
archetypes.mission: weekday worker buildings and trip ends
archetypes.decision_object: street-facing unit with independent public entrance outside host control
archetypes.required_gate: independent street storefront routed to qualified workplace access proxies within the 5/8-minute contract
prohibited_substitutions: resident population cannot replace worker demand
jobs cannot be labelled observed attendance

archetypes.name: Office-lobby counter
archetypes.mission: occupants, registered visitors and explicitly connected concourse users
archetypes.required_gate: named office building, controlled lobby/concourse zone and live landlord unit
prohibited_substitutions: external resident or street population cannot be added as lobby demand
jobs cannot replace occupancy or access

archetypes.name: Private members-club cafe
archetypes.mission: Primary evidence components: CAPTIVE_HOST
archetypes.decision_object: governed private club with observed membership/guest access, exact internal cafe zone and active time-bounded operator opportunity
archetypes.required_gate: named club, membership/access regime, internal zone and operator opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: nearby affluence cannot create club members
club presence cannot create an operating right

archetypes.name: Public-space kiosk
archetypes.mission: accessible park or plaza paths, entrances and hosted activity
archetypes.decision_object: exact current concession or RFP site
archetypes.required_gate: active concession/RFP and exact park, plaza or municipal-space site
prohibited_substitutions: park interior supply cannot replace accessible entrance demand
attractive public space cannot create availability

archetypes.name: Regional terminal / ferry concourse
archetypes.mission: scheduled passengers and workers traversing the same terminal circulation
archetypes.decision_object: current concession space in the governed terminal zone
archetypes.required_gate: named terminal/concourse/boarding zone and live concession
prohibited_substitutions: nearby population cannot replace terminal passenger flow
scheduled service cannot replace traversals

archetypes.name: Reservation coffee / tea salon
archetypes.mission: Primary evidence components: TOURIST_VISITOR, SHOPPING_ERRAND
archetypes.decision_object: available public unit supporting reservation, table service, long dwell, accessibility, restroom, kitchen/service and declared session program
archetypes.required_gate: destination contract plus reservation/table-service unit and program feasibility
prohibited_substitutions: affluence or property price cannot create reservations
planned occasion cannot be inferred from generic footfall

archetypes.name: Residential amenity cafe
archetypes.mission: Primary evidence components: CAPTIVE_HOST, RESIDENT_BASE
archetypes.decision_object: named residential building or complex with observed cafe amenity, internal access regime and active operator authorization
archetypes.required_gate: named residential building/complex, amenity access zone and live operator opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: neighborhood residents cannot replace authorized building occupants
residential units cannot create amenity usage

archetypes.name: Retail shop-in-shop
archetypes.mission: trips and employees attached to the same store footprint
archetypes.required_gate: named partner store, internal location and live operating agreement
prohibited_substitutions: store count or reviews cannot replace store trips
nearby shoppers cannot be added without entering the host

archetypes.name: Scheduled-rail-adjacent street express
archetypes.mission: directional passenger entry and exit flow
archetypes.decision_object: independent street storefront outside controlled station circulation
archetypes.required_gate: independent street storefront routed to governed passenger entrance within the 3/5-minute contract
prohibited_substitutions: scheduled departures cannot be labelled passenger population
station centroid cannot replace entrance routing
